name: Preaching
overview: Scripture presents preaching as a divinely empowered task, exemplified by Moses who, though slow of speech, was assured by God that He would guide his words (Exodus 4:10-12). The title "the Preacher," attributed to Solomon, highlights the role of proclaiming wisdom and truth (Ecclesiastes 1:1,12). Additionally, the strength ordained from the mouths of the humble, such as children, underscores that effective preaching is not dependent on human eloquence but on God's enabling (Psalms 8:2).
